title: Orestes of Thessaly
summary: Raleigh names Orestes of Thessaly in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Orestes, who perswaded the Athenians to attempt Thessalie, and whom King Pharsalus had chased out of his Dominions. He is not Orestes of Mycenae in the chronological table. The one-word title would fold onto that record, so the title is three words. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.
